name: abi_tag
documentation: Adds ABI tags to the mangled name of the entity.

name: address_space
documentation: Places objects of the type in the given target address space.

name: alias
documentation: Defines the entity as an alias of the named symbol.

name: aligned
documentation: Raises the alignment to the given number of bytes, or to the largest alignment of the target when no argument is given.

name: always_inline
documentation: Inlines every call to the function.

name: asm
documentation: Gives the entity the named symbol in the object file.

name: assume
documentation: Lets the implementation assume that the expression evaluates to true at this point.

name: buffer
documentation: Binds a kernel parameter to the buffer at the given index: a pointer to address-space-1 or address-space-2 float, int or unsigned int elements is a runtime-sized storage buffer, and a reference to an address-space-2 scalar or vector is a uniform buffer.

name: constructor
documentation: Calls the function before main, in increasing priority order.

name: deprecated
documentation: Marks the entity as deprecated.

name: enable_if
documentation: Makes the function a viable overload candidate only when the condition is true.

name: exclude_from_explicit_instantiation
documentation: Excludes the member from explicit instantiation declarations and definitions of its class.

name: export_name
documentation: Exports the function from the WebAssembly module under the given name.

name: ext_vector_type
documentation: Declares an extended vector type with the given number of elements.

name: fallthrough
documentation: Marks an intentional fall through to the next switch label.

name: global_id
documentation: Binds an unsigned int, or a vector of 2 or 3 unsigned ints, to the global invocation id.

name: gnu_inline
documentation: Gives the inline function the GNU inline semantics.

name: import_module
documentation: Imports the function from the given WebAssembly module.

name: import_name
documentation: Imports the function under the given WebAssembly field name.

name: indeterminate
subjects: automatic variable definitions and function parameters
documentation: Gives the object an indeterminate instead of an erroneous value until it is initialized.

name: kernel
documentation: Declares the function as a compute kernel entry point.

name: likely
documentation: Marks the path of execution through the statement as more likely than the alternatives.

name: local_id
documentation: Binds an unsigned int, or a vector of 2 or 3 unsigned ints, to the local invocation id.

name: maybe_unused
documentation: Suppresses warnings about the entity being unused.

name: no_unique_address
documentation: Allows the data member to share its address with other subobjects.

name: nodiscard
documentation: Warns when the result of a call is discarded.

name: noinline
documentation: Prevents the function from being inlined.

name: noreturn
documentation: Specifies that the function does not return.

name: nothrow
documentation: Declares that the function does not throw exceptions.

name: packed
documentation: Lays out the members without padding.

name: section
documentation: Places the entity in the named object-file section.

name: trivial_abi
documentation: Passes and returns objects of the class in registers even when it has non-trivial special members.

name: unlikely
documentation: Marks the path of execution through the statement as less likely than the alternatives.

name: used
documentation: Emits the entity even when nothing references it.

name: vector_size
documentation: Declares a GNU vector type of the given size in bytes.

name: warn_unused_result
documentation: Warns when the result of a call is discarded.

name: weak
documentation: Gives the declaration weak linkage.

name: workgroup_id
documentation: Binds an unsigned int, or a vector of 2 or 3 unsigned ints, to the workgroup id.

name: workgroup_size
documentation: Sets the workgroup size of the kernel; the default is 1, 1, 1.
